==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I went to the museum to check out the Egypt exhibit. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) The elven mummies sprung to life and revealed themselves as Lucid Lords with reality warping powers. (The Lucid Lords resemble mummies with pointed elf ears. They always have their arms crossed over their chest. They levitate around with a sparkling purple aura that resembles a night sky full of stars. This aura is their Lucid Light, which they can use to manipulate reality.) They want me to stop using the Reality Warping Stone, because I can already harness the same powers that they possess without it. (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.)
